description: Team IGNISPHERE (Cairo/Giza) builds FlameMargin: an AI fire-safety margin tool for spacecraft cabins trained on NASA's BASS-II ISS fire experiments. It predicts whether a material keeps burning, with uncertainty, flags conditions outside NASA's data (like the Artemis 8.2 psia / 34% O2 atmosphere), and explains results through a grounded AI Copilot. Skills: machine learning, data analysis, combustion science, web apps and AI agents. Live: flamemargin.streamlit.app
